description: This PHP controller class, ReportingMethodController, manages the reporting method configuration within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes a service to fetch reporting method data for rendering a component in the UI.

classes.name: ReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller class that manages reporting method configuration for the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, leveraging Vue.js components for UI rendering.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Provides access to the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with reporting method IDs that are in use, for rendering in the UI.
